title: Expected Value of a Continuous Random Variable
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the mean (expected value) E[X] for f(x) = (1/8) x on [0, 4].

steps.title: State Expected Value Integral
steps.mathExpression: E[X] = \int_0^4 x \cdot f(x) \, dx = \int_0^4 x \left(\frac{1}{8} x\right) dx = \frac{1}{8} \int_0^4 x^2 dx
steps.explanation: Multiply x by f(x) and integrate.
steps.why: First moment definition of expected value.

steps.title: Evaluate Integral
steps.explanation: Simplify the fraction 64/24 by dividing by 8.
